description: Sierra provides an AI agent platform for customer experience teams and enterprises, including tools to build, test, deploy, and optimize customer-facing agents. Its public site describes products such as Agent Studio, Agent SDK, and analytics features for operating those agents across channels.
summary: Public MCP servers are exposed on `api.sierra.chat` for at least Vivid Seats, Redfin, and Remitly; no separate public HTTP, GraphQL, or CLI developer surface for `sierra.chat` was found.
